Du willst Ergebnisse, keine Diskussionen?
Du arbeitest strukturiert, hast ein klares Verständnis für saubere Prozesse und weißt, wie wichtig Verlässlichkeit im Vertrieb ist? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
Wir suchen einen Senior Sales Consultant (m/w/d), der mit klarem Fokus auf Abschlussquote, Systemtreue und messbare Resultate arbeitet. In dieser Position übernimmst du Verantwortung für die direkte Kundengewinnung, führst strukturierte Verkaufsgespräche anhand erprobter Leitfäden und unterstützt beim Ausbau unserer Vertriebsprozesse. Visionen überlassen wir anderen, du bringst Klarheit, Kontrolle und Umsetzung.
Deine Aufgaben
Kundengewinnung mit Struktur: Gezielte Ansprache potenzieller Kunden, Bedarfsanalyse und Führung durch unseren klar definierten Vertriebsprozess.
Pflege stabiler Kundenbeziehungen: Saubere Betreuung mit nachvollziehbaren Abläufen, festen Schritten und dokumentierten Follow-ups.
Vertriebsprozesse umsetzen: Einhaltung von Standards, Arbeit mit KPIs und Sicherstellung, dass kein Schritt ausgelassen wird.
Teamverantwortung übernehmen: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team, klare Übergaben und Orientierung durch feste Strukturen.
Was wir dir bieten
Stabilität & Klarheit: Strukturierte Prozesse, feste Zuständigkeiten und ein durchdachtes Vertriebssystem.
Arbeitsplatz mit Planbarkeit: Geregelte Abläufe, messbare Ergebnisse und ein klarer Erwartungshorizont.
Büro in München: Konzentrationsfördernde Umgebung mit klarer Aufgabentrennung und ruhiger Atmosphäre.
Strukturiertes Onboarding: Systematische Einarbeitung, Schritt für Schritt.
Teamorientierte Umsetzung: Jeder kennt seinen Bereich, alles greift ineinander, ohne Reibungsverluste.
Mehrjährige Vertriebserfahrung, idealerweise im Beratungs- oder Agenturumfeld.
Freude an Zielen, Zahlen und dem sichtbaren Erfolg von klaren Abläufen.
Unternehmerisches Denken, strukturierte Umsetzung und eigenverantwortliches Handeln.
Klare Kommunikation in Deutsch und Englisch, sachlich, effizient, ohne Umwege.
Führung mit Struktur, nicht mit Vision, sondern mit System.

Do you want to join a great startup as SALES & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE (S&BDR) You’re interested in sales and marketing ? You love finding creative solutions to complex issues? You want to work with a young and dynamic team of incredibly driven people, to accelerate our growth?

At Commuty we’re making parking & commuting smarter for companies. We help employees organize their workday in the most efficient, happy and green way! In 5 years, we worked for many types of companies, from small to big ones, such as AG Insurance, Social Lab, L’Oréal or UCB.

We have ambitious goals for the coming months, and we need ambitious new team mates to reach them. We’d love your help here! WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU As a sales/business development representative (S/BDR) you are an inside sales representative that focuses on outreach, prospecting, and lead qualification.

You don’t focus on closing business, but connecting with as many leads as possible ( inbound and outbound) and determining if they’re good customer fits. We will need you to help us move these leads through the sales pipeline. You will work hand in hand with the marketing team and you will be a fueling the pipe and the sales team with great leads.

You will be helping for - contact every lead and determine who stays and who goes. - educate, answer questions, and send resources to potential customers. - Qualify leads and move them through the sales process.

REQUIREMENTS Organization and time management Resilience and determination Great at making first contact Conversational skills Proactive and autonomous Excellent interpersonal skills Rigorous and methodical (results-driven & documentation) Be super fluent in English, and native in French and/or Dutch.

WHAT YOU WILL GET Tremendous growth opportunities Be a part of a dynamic team focused on taking Commuty to the next level Cool work environment that is caring, fun, and collaborative Office in Louvain-la-Neuve & Brussels, with a strong culture of remote work A salary package in line with your experience and skills Last but not least, the satisfaction of making a positive impact on society and employee well-being ‍ A WORD ABOUT COMMUTY Commuty is a Belgian startup founded 6 years ago with the powerful will to make a difference and address environmental challenges of our society.

Our 1st focus is the workplace: we develop a software to improve parking & desk management and boost green mobility in companies & office buildings. We make complex workplace issues become super easy to deal with, thanks to digitization and innovation.

At the end of the day, we help employees organize their workday in the most efficient, happy and green way! INTERESTED? Apply ! If your application is selected we will get in touch to organize: Screening call of 30min Case In-person/videocall Case review interview of 1hr Fit interview with our co-founders of 1 hour‍ Talk soon!

Commuty is a Belgian tech scale-up founded 11 years ago with the powerful will to make a difference and address environmental challenges of our society.

Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we’re focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.

Who We Are BioMarin is a global biotechnology company that relentlessly pursues bold science to translate genetic discoveries into new medicines that advance the future of human health.

Since our founding in 1997, we have applied our scientific expertise in understanding the underlying causes of genetic conditions to create transformative medicines, using a number of treatment modalities. Using our unparalleled expertise in genetics and molecular biology, we develop medicines for patients with significant unmet medical need.

We enlist the best of the best – people with the right technical expertise and a relentless drive to solve real problems – and create an environment that empowers our teams to pursue bold, innovative science.

With this distinctive approach to drug discovery, we’ve produced a diverse pipeline of commercial, clinical and preclinical candidates that have well-understood biology and provide an opportunity to be first-to-market or offer a substantial benefit over existing therapeutic options.

About Commercial Our Commercial organization leads our global sales and marketing strategies around the world. Our integrated team continues to solidify BioMarin’s commercial presence in the United States and Europe and is rapidly growing in other regions, such as Latin America, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific.

BioMarin is the world leader in delivering therapeutics that provide meaningful advances to patients who live with serious and life-threatening rare genetic diseases. We target diseases that lack effective therapies and affect relatively small numbers of patients, many of whom are children.

These conditions are often inherited, difficult to diagnose, progressively debilitating, and have few, if any, treatment options.

BioMarin aims to improve life and health outcomes for people with rare diseases by advocating the use of innovative BioMarin therapeutics, advancing the standard of care and providing personalized support and services globally. BioMarin’s Commercial organization supports our global sales and marketing efforts around the world.

Our global sales force continues to solidify the company’s commercial presence in the United States and Europe and is rapidly growing in other regions, such as Latin America, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific. Come join our team and make a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.

Flexible Growth Path: After around 6 months, successful Sales Executives may choose to move to an uncapped commission model or continue with the deal-based bonus system.

Learn the Product Inside Out: Master the technical side of our custom glass products so you can confidently answer any client question and eliminate doubts.

Close Deals and Secure Deposits: Drive high-energy communication with US buyers to lock a prepayment, close the deal, and hand the project off to the Project Management team.

Benefits English: C1+ / near-native spoken English for daily calls with U.S. clients. Sales Experience: 2 - 3+ years of sales experience, preferably in closing roles. Nice to have: experience in consultative sales. Remote Work Experience: Previous experience working remotely is strongly preferred. U.S.

Market Experience: Experience working with U.S.-based clients is a strong advantage. Negotiation: Strong negotiation skills with the ability to build trust and explain product value clearly. Ability to handle client objections professionally and confidently. CRM Discipline: Experience working with CRM systems; HubSpot experience is a plus.

Product Learning: Ability and willingness to learn a technical/custom product in detail. Conditions Required performance metrics: during the ramp-up period, meet a clear deal-based closure plan. As you progress, targets may evolve based on your selected growth path and compensation model.

A solid hourly base rate + structured deal-based bonuses for each closed deal during the initial period, with the opportunity to move to an uncapped commission model after approximately 6 months. Structured promotion and growth system with regular review opportunities to level up your base rate, bonus structure, and earning potential.

Compensation in US dollars. Comprehensive internal product bootcamps, sharp sales training sessions, and interactive role-play simulations to help you master our custom solutions and close faster. Paid days off, paid sick leave, US public holidays. Why Join Us?

Retail Inside Sales Team Lead is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing a team of Reverse Mortgage Loan Officers within a national consumer-direct sales environment. The Team Lead is accountable for driving sales performance, improving conversion metrics, ensuring compliance adherence, and fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer-focused service.

Through data-driven coaching, performance management, and operational partnership, the Team Lead works to maximize production while supporting employee development and organizational goals.

Drive team performance through consistent coaching, accountability, and sales leadership.
Lead sales discussions, brainstorming sessions, and best-practice sharing to improve individual and team performance.
Promote a results-oriented culture focused on achieving and exceeding sales objectives.
Monitor and improve lead conversion rates throughout the sales process.

Facilitate best-practice sharing across the team to promote continuous learning and collaboration.

About SafeLease
At SafeLease , we're rethinking how P&C insurance is sold in an age of technological change. We believe the industry's biggest inefficiencies aren't technical problems — they're structural ones. And we're building the team to tackle them.
SafeLease is a profitable insurance business that designs, underwrites, and distributes specialty coverage for commercial property owners and their tenants. Most insurance companies either distribute products or bear the risk — we do both.

We back our policies with our own capital, which means we control the full stack: product design, tech, and the speed at which we move. That end-to-end ownership lets us offer customers real flexibility, saving time and money for more than 4,000 properties insured for billions in value nationwide.
We're a team of 70, growing over 100% annually, and we've done it without sacrificing profitability or culture. Here, you'll get high discretion and a wide aperture of problems to solve. We embrace the newest technologies, move fast together, and operate with the intensity of a small company where every person's work is visible. If you're looking for a place to sharpen your craft alongside people who take their work seriously, you'll fit right in.

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), Manufactured Housing , you’ll be an early member of the team responsible for building SafeLease ’s presence within the Manufactured Housing industry.
You’ll own top-of-funnel prospecting to identify, engage, and qualify Manufactured Housing operators across the country. You’ll often be reaching senior and C-suite executives, so success in this role requires more than simply making a high volume of calls. You’ll need to be curious, confident, empathetic, and capable of having thoughtful business conversations with sophisticated buyers.
As one of the first BDRs dedicated to this market, you’ll also have a meaningful role in helping us build the playbook . You’ll test messaging, learn directly from the market, identify what resonates with operators, and share those insights with sales and leadership as we refine our go-to-market strategy.
The ideal candidate is highly coachable, competitive, comfortable with ambiguity, and excited by the opportunity to help build something.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to accelerate their sales career while making an impact from day one. High-performing BDRs will have opportunities for career growth within a company where exceptional performance is recognized and rewarded.

s.h: We're looking for Business Development Representatives
s.t:
We’re building a new insurance business from the ground up to protect SMEs, and we’re looking for Business Development Representatives to join our team. If you’re a high-energy communicator who loves building relationships and wants to gain experience, qualifications, and career progression at a leading fintech, apply now.
The company
We're here because we believe in SMEs. We believe they deserve better than confusing jargon, slow and outdated customer experiences, and being caught out by hidden conditions and fees. And we believe it's our job to help them navigate risk with confidence.
Since 2012, iwoca has made finance fast, flexible, and fair for over 150,000 businesses. Now, we're doing the same for insurance. We're building a brand new insurance business from the ground up — to protect SMEs in the moments that matter most.
Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed by providing access to better finance and services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team is a small, entrepreneurial group responsible for launching iwoca's new SME insurance business. Here’s how the team work together:
Customer-obsessed: The team challenges itself to build insurance that its customers actually want, rather than what insurers simply want to sell.
Curious & supportive: The team collaborates across disciplines to find creative solutions to complex problems in a safe and supportive environment.
Move fast & have fun: The team is fast-paced and highly autonomous, but makes sure to celebrate wins and have fun along the way.
Ambitious & entrepreneurial: The environment is ideal for people who thrive on taking ownership of their work and are ready to roll up their sleeves and build.

You’ll be the person introducing our new insurance offering to businesses who are tired of the status quo. You’ll help SMEs move away from complicated, slow insurance policies and make them aware of a fairer, more transparent way to protect their business.

Proactively engage with SME business operators by phone ahead of their business insurance renewal date to offer a better alternative.
Master the art of the pitch—navigating gatekeepers, articulating our value proposition, and turning objections into opportunities for our brokers to help them.
Manage your pipeline end-to-end within our HubSpot CRM, ensuring meticulous record-keeping and proactive follow-ups so that no opportunity is missed.
Collaborate closely with our in-house brokers and wider team to turn early customer feedback into insights that refine our product offering and sales strategy.

Previous experience navigating outbound or client-facing interactions within a professional business environment.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to build rapport, influence decisions, and handle commercial objections over the phone and email.
A high-energy, resilient, and results-oriented personality that thrives on achieving goals. You have sharp problem-solving instincts and a "can-do" mindset.
Organised and proactive approach to managing your workload.
Ability to adapt and excel in a fast-moving, high-growth atmosphere.
Eagerness to learn - insurance industry experience isn’t necessary - we will provide training to help you succeed.
A desire to secure professional qualifications and drive long-term career progression within a rapidly scaling fintech environment

We expect to pay around £30,000 plus bonus for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.
The culture
At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the professional development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage you to explore new areas of interest to help us innovate and improve our products and services.
The offices

s.h: We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work
s.t:
Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.
Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

Flexible working hours.
Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.
A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.
25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.
A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.
Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.
3% Pension contributions on total earnings.
An employee equity incentive scheme.
Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.
Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.
Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

s.h: And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer
s.t:
A learning and development budget for everyone.
Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.
Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated people? And are you curious or passionate about sales?

Retail Insights is Northern Europe’s leading retail forum. We are strengthening the retail ecosystem by building a platform for insights, inspiration, and networking, connecting more than 3,000 leaders yearly from more than 15 countries.
Retail Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

You will play a key role in helping us build some of the world's leading business conferences by bringing the right people into the room.
We will give you the training, tools and responsibility to succeed while continuously challenging you to develop your commercial skills and accelerate your career.
You’ll be based out of our HQ in London, where you will work alongside an ambitious and entrepreneurial team.
Uncapped earning potential: A competitive base salary and attractive commission structure where your results directly impact your earnings.
Rapid development: An opportunity to build exceptional sales skills in a high-performance environment with continuous coaching and feedback.
International exposure: Speak every day with senior executives, investors and business leaders from companies around the world.
International travel: The opportunity to attend our conferences and see first-hand the events and communities you help build.
Unlimited growth potential: We strongly believe in promoting internally and have a track record of giving exceptional performers significant responsibility early in their careers.

Your mission will be to drive revenue by selling delegate passes to senior professionals attending United Media's international conferences.
Your responsibilities will vary; however, some of them will be to:
Drive new business revenue: Proactively reach out to prospective delegates and convert them into paying attendees across our portfolio of conferences.
Own your sales targets: Take responsibility for ambitious monthly revenue targets and consistently work towards exceeding them.
Execute high-volume outreach: Work within a fast-paced outbound sales environment, making 60+ calls per day and creating approximately 10 qualified sales opportunities or proposals.
Own your pipeline: Manage prospects from first conversation through follow-up, proposal and close, ensuring opportunities continue to move forward.
Become an expert: Develop a strong understanding of our conferences, audiences and industries so you can confidently communicate why the right people should be in the room.
Collaborate across teams: Work closely with our marketing, content and conference teams to continuously improve our campaigns and the experience we offer delegates.
What we expect from you
You have a strong work ethic, a high sense of urgency and a genuine desire to succeed. You enjoy competing against ambitious targets, take ownership of your results and are motivated by seeing your own performance improve.
Most importantly, you want to sell . You enjoy the chase, the conversation and the feeling of turning an opportunity into a closed deal.
Drive & ambition: You are highly motivated, competitive and want to be exceptional at what you do.
Commercial mindset: You are excited by targets, revenue and the opportunity to directly influence your earnings through your performance.
Resilience: You are comfortable with a high level of outbound activity and have the persistence to keep going when you hear "no".
Communication: You are confident speaking with new people and can communicate professionally and persuasively over the phone and in writing.
Relationship building: You are genuinely curious about people and able to build rapport quickly with senior professionals.
Organisation: You can prioritise effectively and stay on top of a large number of prospects, conversations and follow-ups.
Growth mindset: You actively seek feedback and continuously look for ways to improve your performance.
Winning mentality: Whether demonstrated through sales, academics, competitive sports, entrepreneurship or another environment, you have evidence of setting ambitious goals and pushing yourself to achieve them.
Previous sales experience is an advantage but not a requirement . We are equally interested in exceptional graduates and early-career candidates who can demonstrate the drive, communication skills and competitive mindset needed to build a successful career in sales.
Start date: Flexible.
Monday–Friday we work from our office next to Sloane Square Station. Due to the collaborative nature of our work, we do not offer remote work.

Vertriebsinnendienst: Technische Beratung und Verkauf
=====================================================
### **Vertriebsinnendienst: Technische Beratung und Verkauf**
Du kennst die Kunststoffbranche und möchtest Kundenanliegen mit technischem Verständnis und kaufmännischem Geschick lösen? Bei uns kannst du aus einer technischen oder kaufmännischen Laufbahn in den Vertriebsinnendienst einsteigen. Wir arbeiten dich gezielt in die Aufgaben ein.
Über uns
---------
Die Lenorplastics AG vertreibt in der Schweiz technische Kunststoffgranulate führender Hersteller. Wir begleiten unsere Kunden von der Materialauswahl bis zur Serienanwendung und verbinden technische Beratung mit zuverlässiger Belieferung. Eigene Lager, Logistik und Labore unterstützen uns dabei. Als Teil der Hromatka Group sind wir in ein europäisches Distributionsnetzwerk eingebunden.
Deine Aufgaben
--------------
Du betreust Bestandskunden telefonisch und per E\-Mail, klärst ihren Bedarf und begleitest ihre Anliegen bis zur Lö bearbeitest Anfragen und Aufträge, erstellst Angebote und verfolgst offene Vorgänge nach. Du gibst eine erste technische Orientierung bei Materialfragen und ziehst bei Bedarf, unsere Fachspezialisten hinzu.

Du unterstützt den Aussendienst im Tagesgeschäft sowie bei Kundenprojekten und erkennst gemeinsam mit ihm zusätzliche Verkaufschancen. Du pflegst Kunden\- und Auftragsdaten im ERP\-System und arbeitest eng mit Einkauf, Lager, Logistik und dem technischen Team zusammen.

Du unterstützt deine Mitarbeiter sowie Schnittstellen im Tagesgeschäft, Projekten oder während Stellvertretungen
Das bringst du mit
------------------

Du hast eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium im Kunststoffumfeld, etwa als Kunststofftechnologe, Polymechaniker im Werkzeugbau oder Spritzguss, Konstrukteur oder Materialingenieur. Du bringst praktische Erfahrung mit und möchtest dich entwickeln, indem du den Vertrieb und die Kundenbetreuung erlernst und lebst.

Du hast eine kaufmännische Grundausbildung oder ein entsprechendes Studium und hast Berufserfahrung in der Kunststoffindustrie sammeln können. Du kennst bereits gewisse technische Ausdrücke sowie die Vorgehen und Eigenheiten der Industrie. Die Kunden, Materialien und Verfahren interessieren dich und du hast Freude daran, dich auch mit den technischen Aspekten der Kundenbetreuung auseinanderzusetzen.
Für beide Profile zählen Freude am Kundenkontakt, eine sorgfältige und selbstständige Arbeitsweise, Teamgeist und die Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen. Du kommunizierst fliessend auf Deutsch und sicher auf Englisch; zusätzliche Französisch\- oder Italienisch\-Kenntnisse sind ein Plus.
Das erwartet dich
-----------------
Eine Einarbeitung abgestimmt auf deinen Hintergrund und ein erfahrenes Team, das Wissen teilt. Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket, Team\-Events und ein kostenloser Parkplatz. Kurze Entscheidungswege und Raum, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln. Eine langfristige Perspektive in einem bewährten, nachhaltig erfolgreichen Unternehmen.

### Technischer Außendienst (m/w/d) für die Westschweiz \- Gebiet Romandie
Mit mehr als 20 Jahren Erfahrung, bieten wir Werkstätten zukunftsorientierte Lösungen für Kfz\-Mehrmarkendiagnose, Fahrzeugkalibrierung, Klimaservice und Abgasuntersuchung. Wir sind Spezialisten und einer der führenden Entwickler für Fahrzeugdiagnose.
Bei uns fließt nicht nur Arbeit, sondern Herzblut und Leidenschaft in jeden Tag ein.
Diese Werte sind unser Antrieb, der uns seit über 20 Jahre Erfolgsgeschichte schreiben lässt.
### Deine Aufgaben
* Betreuung von Bestandskunden und Gewinnung neuer Kunden im Bereich Wartung und Vertrieb technischer Produkte (Werkstattausrüstung).
* Deine Kunden berätst und schulst Du hinsichtlich der Einsatzmöglichkeiten und erarbeitest individuelle Lösungen.
* Durch Deine kompetente Beratung und Präsenz am Markt erschließt Du gezielt Geschäftspotentiale und gewinnst neue Kunden und Wartungsverträge.
* Deine Aktivitäten pflegst und planst Du selbstständig.
### Dein Profil
* Du hast Spaß, etwas zu bewegen, Netzwerke auszubauen und Kunden durch kompetente Beratung und Service zu begeistern.
* Du hast eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Mechaniker, Automobilfachmann (m/w/d) oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung im technischen Bereich.
* Die Betreuung von Bestandskunden und Gewinnung neuer Kunden ist Deine Leidenschaft.
* Eigeninitiative, ein strukturierter Arbeitsstil, Team\-Spirit sowie die erforderliche Reisebereitschaft bringst Du mit. Du agierst vom Home\-Office.
* Berufserfahrung im Umfeld von Kfz\-Werkstätten ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung \- mit technischer Affinität wirst Du bestens auf Deine Aufgabe vorbereitet.
* Fließende Deutsch\- und Französischkenntnisse sind zwingende Voraussetzung.
* Wohnort im Verkaufsgebiet in der Westschweiz ist zwingend erforderlich (idealerweise Grossraum Fribourg, Lausanne oder Biel)

* Eine spannende und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem innovativen Unternehmen.
